verdict.rationale: Aider is itself a coding agent, which makes it an MCP client rather than a server. Serving tools to other agents via an official MCP server is a different product role. Nothing in the evidence shows an 'mcp serve' mode or a first-party hosted MCP endpoint, and the only programmatic surface is an unofficial Python scripting API, which does not make this axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
